mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_no, name, email, password_hash, department_id, role, status, must_change_password, failed_login_count, locked_until, last_login_at, created_at FROM users WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE role = 'SUPER_ADMIN' AND status = 'ACTIVE')
SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'SUPER_ADMIN' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND id <> #{userId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email}))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (employee_no, name, email, password_hash, department_id, role, status, must_change_password) VALUES (#{employeeNo}, #{name}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{departmentId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{mustChangePassword})
mapper.select: UPDATE users SET failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, locked_until = CASE WHEN failed_login_count + 1 >= #{maxFailedAttempts} THEN #{lockedUntil} ELSE locked_until END WHERE id = #{userId} RETURNING locked_until
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, failed_login_count = 0 WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET failed_login_count = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt} WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = FALSE WHERE id = #{userId}
